notes.title: The crazy, depraved billiards game, Rabbit Burn is released!
notes.content:

notes.title: [Patch note Ver.1.002] Improved game stability and fixed minor bugs.
notes.content:
Hello, 

We updated the game version.
In case you modified the game files before, please download the newest files and apply them.
[list]
[*]Improved game stability.
[*]Enabled skip battle in tutorial.
[*]Fixed some garbled text of English version.
[/list]

notes.title: Known problems and fixes
notes.content:
[h1]Screen goes black in game tutorial.[/h1]
This problem is caused by some old video card driver.
If you encounter this problem, please update your video card driver.
